content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education International Pathways to HTW Berlin Student Exchange Programmes at HTW Berlin Accomodation Accomodation Table of contents Living in Berlin - good to know Student Residence Victor Jara Living in Berlin - good to know HTW Berlin offers you a lot of useful information about living in Berlin including helpful links to support you, if you are looking for accomodation. Please have a look at Living in Berlin . Student Residence Victor Jara During the application process, you have had the option to apply for one of our dormitory places. Please note that we only have a limited contingent of dormitory places and cannot guarantee a place to all applicants. Please note: It is NOT possible for exchange students to apply directly to the dormitory! Where? For exchange students there are limited places in the Residence Oberfeldstraße Victor Jara of the Studierendenwerk Berlin. This dormitory is located less than 30 min. by public transport/bicycle from our Treskowallee Campus (Business Faculty) and around 45 minutes from our Wilhelminenhof Campus (all other faculties). Address of the Residence Oberfeldstraße 111 and 132 12683 Berlin (Biesdorf) What? In the Residence Oberfeldstraße Victor Jara only single apartments (Apartment for one person) are offered to exchange students, acommodating one person only. These apartments are NOT suitable for couples. All single apartments have got a pantry kitchen and a private bathroom/toilet . They are equipped with a bed, a closet, a desk and a book shelf. Personal belongings such as blankets, pillows, bedding, dishes etc. are not provided. Broadband internet is provided. How much? Monthly rent is about 390-450 EUR, depending on the size of the accommodation. Included are the costs for water, heating, electricity and internet. You have to pay, one time only , an one-off deposit of 2 times the monthly rent, that is 780 to 900 EUR (by bank transfer). It has to be received by the Studierendenwerk Berlin before your arrival alongside the first month's rent. It will be refunded after moving out. When? The rental periods are unalterable , they cannot be changed. winter semester: 01/09 to 28/02 summer semester: 01/03 to 31/08 The minimum rental period is 6 months. Good to know! Please note that it is NOT possible to send mail or shipments to the dormitory before you have moved in. In Germany, there is a mandatory broadcasting fee. More information on this licence fee and how to apply for an exemption can be found here . All information about the Residence Oberfeldstraße Victor Jara , including fotos, a map and public transport, provides the website of the Studierendenwerk Berlin : Residence Oberfeldstraße (Victor Jara) .
